emma (CS): Hey team — customer Hearthly Foods (acct HRT-9002) says invoice INV-2026-0047 was issued without their PO (they supplied PO 4567). They can’t post the invoice. Ticket #12345. Can billing reissue with PO and VAT lines?
alex (Billing): Thanks, emma. Do we have the original invoice PDF or invoice_id? Need to confirm whether payment has been captured before we do credit/reissue.
emma (CS): Attached the invoice snippet they pasted:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0047
Date: 2026-03-10
Amount: 12,480.00 EUR
PO: -
VAT: 0.00
Notes: subscription renewal
```
They say payment was captured on 2026-03-12 via card ending ***4242. Customer explicitly requests credit + reissue (they need PO on invoice for AP).
jason (Eng): Not an API bug — looks like PO wasn’t passed in when invoice created. Might be missing from the webhook that originally created the invoice. But we should avoid touching payments if we can credit+reissue.
sophia (Finance): If payment captured, typical flow is: issue credit note for full amount (negative invoice), then create a new invoice including PO 4567 and correct VAT treatment. We should not refund card unless customer requests refund; keep settlement intact and match new invoice to cash receipt.
emma (CS): Customer prefers reissued invoice applied to existing payment (so no refund). They also mentioned they need VAT broken out and their VAT reg: GB999888777.
alex (Billing): Ok. Proposed steps: 1) Create credit note referencing INV-2026-0047. 2) Create new invoice INV-2026-0047-R1 including PO:4567 and VAT ID GB999888777, same gross amount, same payment reference so reconciliation links to the captured payment. 3) Post credit note and new invoice in the system and export PDF to send to customer. 4) Tag ticket and confirm with customer when done.
billing-bot: Created billing task BILL-7890 for credit note creation (assignee: alex).
alex (Billing): I’ll open the credit note now. For audit, include original payment id and settlement date. Using internal billing UI is faster, but here's the API payload if we need to script it:
```
POST /v1/billing/credits
{
  "original_invoice_id": "INV-2026-0047",
  "amount": 12480.00,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "reason": "Reissue with PO 4567",
  "reference": "credit_for_reissue_12345"
}
```
Then new invoice:
```
POST /v1/invoices
{
  "customer_id": "HRT-9002",
  "po_number": "4567",
  "vat_id": "GB999888777",
  "line_items": [...same as original...],
  "reference_payment_id": "pm_abc123"  // link to the captured payment
}
```
sophia (Finance): Make sure GL entries: credit note hits revenue reversal code REV-CLX, new invoice posts under standard revenue. Also add note: "Reissued for PO 4567; original invoice INV-2026-0047 credited." I’ll approve once you attach the draft PDFs.
emma (CS): I updated the support ticket with the plan and told the customer we expect ~24-48h for internal processing and will send the new PDF when ready.
alex (Billing): Drafted credit note and new invoice in staging. Two quick checks for prod: 1) confirm payment id (pm_abc123) matches the transaction; 2) confirm VAT treatment — customer on GB register so we should show VAT 20% line unless reverse charge applies.
jason (Eng): For future prevention, I’ll add validation in the invoice creation flow: if customer provided po_number in the order payload, require it be persisted or surface a warning. Filing a small engineering task.
billing-bot: Billing task BILL-7890 updated: credit created (ID CR-2026-0012), new invoice created (INV-2026-0047-R1).
alex (Billing): Credit note CR-2026-0012 created and posted. New invoice INV-2026-0047-R1 generated with PO 4567 and VAT ID GB999888777. Marking for reconciliation. Will attach PDFs to ticket.
sophia (Finance): Approved. After reconciling, do not issue refund. Apply cash to INV-2026-0047-R1.
emma (CS): Customer notified and uploaded PDFs. They confirmed PO shows correctly. Closing loop.
alex (Billing): Closing billing task. If accounting needs the refund instead, reopen.
emma (CS): Thanks all :tada: — updating ticket status to resolved.
